_doc: AppGallery privacy tags for this app. Labels are the exact console names from https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/doc/app/privacy-label . Baseline generated from the manifest permissions plus the mandatory Petal Ads block; add the app-specific items the code really stores or processes (e.g. Transaction records for receipts). Validate with: python factory/tools/privacy_tags.py check <slug>

Device information: Other hardware and software parameters/System settings
Other hardware and software parameters/System settings

not_applicable.Product personalization: No user profiling; ad personalisation belongs to the Petal Ads scenario.
not_applicable.Cross-border transfer: Scenario means data sent outside the Chinese mainland; the app is not distributed in the Chinese mainland.

item_notes.Acceleration sensor: Petal Ads SDK: motion data used for ad-fraud detection.
item_notes.App usage information: Ad events (impressions, clicks) reported by the Petal Ads SDK.
item_notes.Basic app information: Package name and version sent by the Petal Ads SDK with ad requests.
item_notes.Device status: Petal Ads SDK: battery and storage status.
item_notes.Gyroscope: Petal Ads SDK: motion data used for ad-fraud detection.
item_notes.IP address: Petal Ads SDK: network address of each ad request.
item_notes.Image or video: Plant photos taken through the system camera app or picked from the gallery; stored in app-private storage on the device only.
item_notes.Network type: Petal Ads SDK: Wi-Fi or mobile network type.
item_notes.OAID: Read by the Huawei Petal Ads SDK for ad delivery and measurement.
item_notes.OS information: Petal Ads SDK: Android/EMUI version for ad delivery.
item_notes.Other approximate location information: Petal Ads derives city/country from the IP address.
item_notes.Other hardware and software parameters/S: Petal Ads SDK: device brand/model, screen resolution, language, region.
